fixed.correction: The dictation called TR a 'book on dropped borders.' It is neither. (1) 'Flow-based border drops' are an internal fix for IN-footprint Core-FBMC borders (AT-SI, CZ-SK...) - nothing to do with TR. (2) TR is simply never in the footprint, so its flow is injected as an observed schedule. The BG-TR p95-block recipe in the code (boundary.jl comment) is the ANCESTOR of the UA sizing, not a TR book. If TR ever gets an elastic book it will be a new pillar-6 item - today it has none.
roadmap: A defensible TR fundamentals anchor. GB works because we can build GB CCGT SRMC from TTF + UK-ETS. TR's fleet is gas + lignite + hydro + a large and growing nuclear (Akkuyu) block, priced off BOTAS gas and a TL-denominated cost base with NO EU-ETS carbon - none of which is in our feeds. Without a defensible TR marginal cost, an elastic anchor would be a guess, and the rule is that a declared anchor must be defensible, not invented.
A demonstrated-capability series for the BG-TR / GR-TR borders - we already have this (the p95-block recipe), so this is the easy half.

A reason to believe TR bids elastically at the day-ahead horizon across a non-synchronous interconnection with its own market design, plus a measured confirm A/B on the coupled footprint showing GR/BG improve within a regime with zero new cap-hours and no envelope breach. Until that exists, fixed injection is the honest choice - the absence of a TR book is a DECISION, not an oversight.

descriptions.v3: Per border: MEAN of (a) the load-analogue median - the median observed flow of the 16 trailing-365-day days whose D-1 load-forecast vector is nearest to the delivery day's (the ex-ante thermometer: warm days look like warm days), and (b) the D-2 observed flow (the fastest admissible signal, catches a regime change within 48h); PLUS the D-7 recency component on Norwegian reservoir borders.

flow_rule.audit_note: We caught our own lookahead. The pipelined RECORDS through cv24 were NOT ex-ante on flows - the book workers silently used :d0 (same-day observed) instead of the scoped :v3 default the ledger documents. The audit found it (docs/experiments/exante-audit-2026-07.md) and cv25 closed it. The live forecast path was always correct. This is exactly the kind of honesty the whole site advertises.
